pages.text: Twelve steps of storage. Capacity quadruples each step, and throughput is a hundredth of capacity, so a bigger cell is also a faster one.$(br2)Tier 1 holds a million FE and moves ten thousand a tick. Tier 10 holds 262 billion.$(br2)The bars on the casing light up as the cell fills, and it glows a little brighter with them.

pages.title: The last two
pages.text: $(6)Tier 11$() has no ceiling at all: it takes whatever it is given and never fills.$(br2)$(6)The Creative Cell$() is the other way round: it never empties, whatever you draw from it. It has no recipe and is only in the creative tab.

pages.title: Behaviour
pages.text: A cell pushes into whatever is next to it, but never into another cell that is fuller than it is, so a bank of cells levels out instead of shuffling the same power back and forth.$(br2)It emits a comparator signal for its fill level, keeps its charge when broken, and works from your inventory: a charged cell in your bag can top up a tool.
